services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: When searching for a charter there are a couple things to look for other than rates. Your charter should be booked due to your confidence in the captain and the quality of the service you expect. Rates, I hate to say it, are a good reflection on the quality of the charter you will be taking. When you think you are getting a deal or a longer trip for your money there is usually a reason for that. Believe me I know I am not going to book all the trips from the people who look on this site, but I truly want you to have a quality fishing experience here in Milwaukee even if you don’t book with us.
